blocks.t: Protect your industrial facility, commercial warehouse, or high-risk property with the AFFF Foam Type Fire Extinguisher from Apex Fire Safety. Filled with high-performance Aqueous Film-Forming Foam (AFFF), this unit discharges a water-based foam solution that blankets fuel surfaces, starves flames of oxygen, and creates a durable vapor seal to prevent dangerous re-ignition.

As a trusted fire protection supplier in Pakistan, Apex Fire Safety delivers certified AFFF extinguishers designed to tackle high-intensity Class A (solid combustibles) and Class B (flammable liquids) hazards efficiently.
How AFFF Foam Technology Works
When activated, the pressurized nitrogen propellant discharges the foam solution. The foam rapidly spreads over liquid fuels (such as petrol, diesel, and solvents), forming a thin aqueous film that:

blocks.label: Smothers the Fire
blocks.t: Cuts off the supply of oxygen instantly.

blocks.label: Cools the Fuel
blocks.t: Absorbs heat to lower the surface temperature.

blocks.label: Suppresses Vapors
blocks.t: Seals flammable gases below the blanket to block flashovers and re-ignition.
Key Features & Technical Specifications

blocks.label: Fire Class Rating

Primary Applications
AFFF Foam Extinguishers are essential for spaces where flammable liquid storage and solid combustible hazards coexist:
Petrol Pumps & Fuel Stations

Critical Safety Warnings

blocks.label: Electrical Hazard
blocks.t: Standard AFFF foam contains water and is electrically conductive. DO NOT use on live electrical panels, servers, or wiring unless certified and isolated. Use a CO₂ or Dry Powder Extinguisher for electrical fires.

blocks.label: Deep-Fat Cooking Oils (Class F)
blocks.t: Do not use on commercial kitchen deep fryers. Install a Wet Chemical Fire Extinguisher instead.

blocks.label: Alcohol & Polar Solvents
blocks.t: Standard AFFF breaks down when applied to alcohol fires. Use AR-AFFF (Alcohol-Resistant) foam for storage areas containing ethanol or acetone.

blocks.t: Safeguard your high-voltage electrical assets, sensitive IT infrastructure, and commercial machinery with the CO₂ (Carbon Dioxide) Fire Extinguisher from Apex Fire Safety. Powered by pure, non-conductive carbon dioxide gas, this premium unit rapidly extinguishes fires by starving the flame of oxygen and absorbing thermal energy. Because CO₂ evaporates completely without leaving messy powders or liquid residue, it ensures zero secondary damage or post-fire cleanup for critical electronics.

As a leading fire protection supplier in Pakistan, Apex Fire Safety provides certified CO₂ extinguishers engineered to handle high-risk Class B (flammable liquids) and Class C (energized electrical) fire hazards.
How CO₂ Suppression Technology Works
When activated, liquid carbon dioxide expands rapidly upon discharge through a non-conductive horn, transforming into a dense cloud of cold CO₂ gas. This process:

blocks.label: Displaces Oxygen
blocks.t: Starves the fire by reducing atmospheric oxygen surrounding the flame below combustion thresholds.

blocks.label: Cools the Hazard
blocks.t: Absorbs heat through rapid expansion, lowering fuel temperatures.

blocks.label: Leaves Zero Residue
blocks.t: Evaporates 100% cleanly into the atmosphere, making it completely safe for delicate circuit boards, servers, and optic systems.
Key Features & Technical Specifications

blocks.label: Fire Class Rating
blocks.t: Class B (Petrol, Diesel, Oils, Paints, Solvents) & Class C (Live Electrical Panels, Server Racks, Machinery).

blocks.label: Available Capacities
blocks.t: 2 kg, 3 kg, 5 kg (Portable Units), and 9 kg / 22.5 kg / 45 kg (Wheeled Trolley Units).

blocks.label: Cylinder Construction
blocks.t: Seamless high-pressure alloy steel or aluminum cylinder with corrosion-resistant red epoxy powder finish.

blocks.label: Identification
blocks.t: Standard Black Color Code / Band for immediate visual identification in emergency conditions.

blocks.label: Discharge Mechanism
blocks.t: High-grade chrome-plated brass valve with safety relief disc, locking pin, and a non-conductive frost-free discharge horn.

blocks.label: Working Pressure

CO₂ Fire Extinguishers are mandatory for locations requiring residue-free suppression for electrical and liquid hazards:

blocks.label: Electrical Panels & Data Centers

blocks.label: Computers & Office Electronics
blocks.t: Ideal for protecting workstations, CCTV monitoring rooms, and server farms without risking chemical damage.

blocks.label: Laboratories & Healthcare

blocks.label: Industrial Automation & Machinery
blocks.t: Perfect for protecting CNC machines, printing presses, and automated control cabinets.

blocks.t: Protects commercial microwave units, ovens, and motorized food prep equipment (power must be isolated).

blocks.label: Hot Work & Maintenance

Critical Safety Warnings & Limitations

blocks.label: Class A Solid Combustibles
blocks.t: CO₂ is not effective for deep-seated Class A fires (wood, paper, textiles) as flames may re-ignite after the gas dissipates. Use a Water or AFFF Foam Extinguisher for solid combustibles.

blocks.label: Outdoor / High-Wind Areas
blocks.t: CO₂ gas disperses rapidly in outdoor or ventilated environments, reducing its extinguishing concentration.

blocks.label: Frostbite Hazard
blocks.t: The discharge horn gets extremely cold during operation. Always hold the extinguisher by the insulated handle grip to prevent thermal skin burns.

blocks.label: Confined Space Evacuation
blocks.t: In small, unventilated rooms, CO₂ displaces breathable air. Evacuate immediately after discharging to prevent asphyxiation.

blocks.t: Protect your industrial facility, commercial warehouse, office, or residential property with the multi-purpose DCP (Dry Chemical Powder) Fire Extinguisher from Apex Fire Safety. Formulated with high-grade Monoammonium Phosphate dry powder, this versatile extinguisher rapidly smothers flames by interrupting the chemical chain reaction of combustion, knocking down fires in seconds.

As a trusted fire protection supplier in Pakistan, Apex Fire Safety provides certified DCP extinguishers designed to handle Class A (solid combustibles), Class B (flammable liquids), Class C (flammable gases), and live electrical hazards with maximum efficiency.
How DCP Suppression Technology Works
When activated, the pressurized propellant forces a dense cloud of micro-fine dry chemical powder over the burning material. This multi-action process:

blocks.label: Interrupts Combustion
blocks.t: Microscopic chemical particles break down the chemical chain reaction of the fire.

blocks.label: Blankets the Fuel
blocks.t: Smothers the fuel source to cut off the supply of oxygen immediately.

blocks.label: Forms a Thermal Shield
blocks.t: Creates a protective barrier against extreme radiant heat, shielding nearby structures and personnel during emergency response.
Key Features & Technical Specifications

blocks.label: Fire Class Rating
blocks.t: Multi-purpose Class A (Wood, Paper, Textiles), Class B (Petrol, Diesel, Oil, Paints), Class C (Propane, Methane, Gases), and Live Electrical Equipment.

blocks.label: Available Capacities

blocks.label: Cylinder Construction
blocks.t: Heavy-duty, deep-drawn cold-rolled steel cylinder with internal anti-corrosion coating and UV-resistant red polyester powder finish.

DCP Dry Powder Extinguishers are the most widely deployed fire safety units across industrial, commercial, and transport sectors:

blocks.label: Multi-Class Versatility
blocks.t: Single-unit protection for solid combustibles, liquid fuels, and gas leaks.

blocks.label: Non-Conductive & Safe
blocks.t: Powder does not conduct electricity, making it safe for live electrical sub-panels, generators, and transformers.

blocks.t: Rapid flame suppression prevents small initial fires from turning into major blazes.

Critical Safety Warnings & Limitations

blocks.t: Dry powder leaves a fine, non-conductive residue that can contaminate server circuits, optical equipment, and precision machinery. For data centers, server rooms, and medical labs, install Halotron Clean Agent or CO₂ Extinguishers.

As a leading turn-key fire protection contractor in Pakistan, Apex Fire Safety provides NFPA 2001-compliant design, engineering, hydraulic modeling, supply, installation, commissioning, refilling, and maintenance services for FM-200 systems nationwide.
How FM-200 Clean Agent Suppression Works

FM-200 (HFC-227ea) is a colorless, odorless, and electrically non-conductive gaseous clean agent stored as a liquid in high-pressure cylinders. When triggered by early-warning smoke detectors, the system discharges gaseous agent through engineered piping networks within 10 seconds, extinguishing flames through:

blocks.label: Heat Absorption
blocks.t: Disperses rapidly throughout the protected room to absorb thermal energy at the molecular level, bringing temperatures below ignition thresholds.

blocks.label: Chemical Interruption
blocks.t: Interrupts the free-radical chemical chain reaction of the flame.

blocks.label: Zero Residue & Safe Dispersal
blocks.t: Evaporates 100% cleanly into the atmosphere without damaging circuit boards, hard drives, or magnetic media, eliminating post-fire cleanup costs.

blocks.label: Occupant Safety
blocks.t: Safe for human-occupied spaces at standard design concentrations (7% to 9%), making it ideal for active control rooms and staff environments.
Key System Components & Specifications

blocks.label: Extinguishing Agent
blocks.t: HFC-227ea (Heptafluoropropane / FM-200).

blocks.label: Compliance Standards
blocks.t: Designed, calculated, and installed according to NFPA 2001 (Standard on Clean Agent Fire Extinguishing Systems) and ISO 14520 standards.

blocks.label: Storage Pressure
blocks.t: Stored as a liquid super-pressurized with dry Nitrogen gas at 25 bar (360 psi) or 42 bar (600 psi).

blocks.label: System Activation
blocks.t: Multi-stage automatic detection via cross-zoned photoelectric smoke detectors, thermal detectors, or manual release stations.

blocks.label: Control Unit
blocks.t: Intelligent clean-agent release control panel with battery backup, abort switches, solenoid actuators, line monitoring, and acoustic alarm sounders/strobes.

blocks.label: Nozzle & Pipe Network
blocks.t: Precision-engineered 360° and 180° directional discharge nozzles connected through high-pressure schedule 40/80 seamless piping.

blocks.label: Environmental Profile
blocks.t: Zero Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP) and EPA SNAP-approved clean agent.

Types of Water Fire Suppression Systems We Offer
Depending on your facility layout, fire hazard classification, and environmental sensitivity, Apex Fire Safety designs and installs three main categories of water-based suppression systems:

blocks.label: Fire Sprinkler Systems (Wet Pipe & Dry Pipe)
blocks.t: Wet Pipe Systems: The most common configuration, featuring pipes constantly filled with pressurized water for instant discharge when heat shatters a sprinkler bulb. Dry Pipe & Pre-Action Systems: Designed for freezing environments or sensitive storage areas (such as cold storages or electronic warehouses) where pipes remain filled with pressurized air or nitrogen until detection triggers water release, preventing accidental leaks.

blocks.label: Water Mist Fire Suppression Systems
blocks.t: Utilizes ultra-fine, high-pressure water droplets (mist) to extinguish fires using up to 80% less water than traditional sprinklers. Rapidly evaporates to absorb extreme heat and displace oxygen at the flame base, making it ideal for machinery spaces, turbine enclosures, generator rooms, and heritage buildings.

blocks.label: Deluge Fire Suppression Systems
blocks.t: Features open spray nozzles connected to a piping network controlled by a deluge valve. Upon detection signal, the valve opens to discharge massive volumes of water simultaneously across all nozzles, providing high-velocity flooding for high-risk hazards such as chemical storage, transformer yards, and fuel loading racks.

Fire Door Purpose

Fire doors create a passive fire safety system, protecting commercial buildings from the spread of fire by confining it to a specific area for a longer period of time. This allows people within the building enough time to escape via alternative routes which might otherwise be cut off by fire. They are a legal requirement for particular buildings, including for flats and commercial property, but the prime purpose for fire doors is to save precious lives and halt the progress of a destructive fire.

lead: LPCB certified to EN54-2/4, Context Plus’s CFP 8 zone conventional fire alarm panel offers an array of user and installer-friendly features at a very competitive price.

Supplied in an attractive flush or surface mountable plastic enclosure, it includes eight detector zones, four conventional sounder circuits, class change and alert inputs, on-board fire and fault relays and combined keypad/keyswitch entry.

A wide range of engineering functions are also provided including selectable zone delays, coincidence and non-latching zone facilities. Comprehensive test and fault finding facilities are also provided.
Optional repeaters and relay expansion boards are also available.

blocks.t: Context Plus 8 Zone Panel is designed and manufactured in the United Kingdom. The Context Plus fire alarm brand is owned by IMCI (Services) Limited. The 8 Zone Panel Context Plus is a conventional panel capable of handling around 240 devices to include smoke and heat detectors, manual call point and notification devices.

The price of a fire alarm system can vary widely depending on a number of factors, including the size of the building, the number of devices (such as smoke detectors, heat sensors, and manual pull stations) needed, the complexity of the system (e.g., whether it needs to be connected to a central monitoring station or has other special features), and the installation costs. Larger and more complex systems tend to cost more.
